checklist.step: Stand up and version the WYO ICFR control matrix
actions: Open the prior-year control matrix workbook in Microsoft Excel and list every control step from output-tape extract through BSA acceptance.
For each control record the control owner, frequency, the GL account ranges and cost centers it covers, and the SAP S/4HANA (GL) transaction codes used to pull the source data.
Compare the current WYO Financial Control Plan bulletin against last year's matrix and flag any new or retired control requirement.
Route the draft matrix to the CFO for annual approval and record the approval date on the cover tab.
checklist.done: the control matrix is current against the latest Financial Control Plan, every control has a named owner and GL scope, and the CFO approval date is recorded.

checklist.step: Extract the monthly WYO output tape from the general ledger
actions: In SAP S/4HANA open the GL extract report for the WYO transaction code range and run it for the closed accounting month.
Build the output tape in the NFIP-prescribed record layout (policy transaction, premium, loss and expense records) and save it under <company>-<yyyymm>-tape.txt.
Cross-check the record count on the tape against the transaction count in the policy administration system for the same month.
Ask the Policy Admin Ops Lead to explain any count difference before the tape moves to reconciliation.
checklist.done: the output tape is built in the prescribed layout and its record count is explained against the policy admin system for the month.

checklist.step: Reconcile the output tape to the general ledger
actions: Open a new BlackLine reconciliation task for the month and load the GL trial balance alongside the output-tape summary totals.
Tie premium written, losses paid/incurred and expense totals on the tape to the corresponding GL account balances line by line.
Book and document any reclass or true-up entry needed to bring the tape into agreement with the GL.
Attach the signed-off reconciliation to the BlackLine task and route it to the Controller for review.
checklist.done: every tape total ties to its GL account with reclass entries documented, and the reconciliation is attached in BlackLine.

checklist.step: Resolve TRRP error codes before re-submission
actions: Run the tape through the internal TRRP pre-edit check and capture the returned error/warning codes.
Look up each code in the current NFIP TRRP Plan of Operations error-code table and identify the source field or transaction causing it.
Correct the source transaction in SAP S/4HANA or the policy administration system, not just the tape file, and re-extract.
Log every error code, its cause and its fix on the monthly TRRP error log.
checklist.done: the tape passes the pre-edit check with zero unresolved error codes and every prior error is logged with its root cause.

checklist.step: Submit the tape and financial statements to the NFIP Bureau and Statistical Agent
actions: Log the submission package (tape file, monthly financial statement, reconciliation summary) into the Internal Regulatory System's WYO filing tracker.
Transmit the package to the BSA through the designated NFIP submission channel ahead of the published cycle close date.
Record the BSA transmission confirmation number and timestamp on the filing tracker entry.
Notify the CFO if the transmission is not acknowledged within one business day.
checklist.done: the package is transmitted before the BSA cycle close date and a BSA confirmation number is recorded in the filing tracker.

checklist.step: Confirm BSA acceptance and clear any rejection
actions: Check the BSA acceptance report for the month against the transmitted package.
For any rejected record, pull the rejection reason code, correct the underlying transaction and re-submit within the BSA's cure window.
Update the filing tracker status to Accepted only after a clean BSA acceptance report is on file.
Escalate to the CFO any rejection that cannot be cured before the next monthly cycle opens.
checklist.done: the filing tracker shows Accepted with a clean BSA acceptance report, or an escalated, owned cure plan for any unresolved rejection.

checklist.step: Write the monthly control narrative and evidence packet
actions: Summarize what was tested, what broke and how it was fixed for the month against each control in the matrix.
Attach the reconciliation, error log, transmission confirmation and BSA acceptance report to the packet.
File the packet against the corresponding control-matrix row so the evidence trail is one click from the control.
checklist.done: a complete evidence packet exists for the month, linked to every control-matrix row it supports.

checklist.step: Perform the quarterly control walkthrough
actions: Select one month's evidence packet per control per quarter and re-perform the control steps end to end.
Interview the control owner on any step where the walkthrough does not match the documented procedure.
Update the control matrix narrative where the actual process has drifted from what is written.
Record the walkthrough result (operating as designed / design gap / no evidence) against each control.
checklist.done: every control has a quarterly walkthrough result recorded, with any design gap logged for remediation.

checklist.step: Log control deficiencies and severity-rate them
actions: Raise a tracker issue for every walkthrough or reconciliation deficiency with the control id, what failed and the financial statement line it affects.
Rate severity as deficiency, significant deficiency or material weakness using the CFO-approved severity criteria.
Assign an owner and a remediation date, escalating any significant deficiency or material weakness to the CFO the same week.
checklist.done: every deficiency is logged, severity-rated and has an owner and remediation date, with significant items escalated to the CFO.

checklist.step: Remediate and re-test the deficient control
actions: Implement the agreed fix (procedure change, system control, additional review step) with the control owner.
Re-perform the control on the next monthly cycle's evidence and confirm the deficiency did not recur.
Close the tracker issue only after two consecutive clean monthly cycles for reconciliation controls.
Update the control matrix with the revised procedure and the remediation date.
checklist.done: the tracker issue is closed only after two clean cycles and the control matrix reflects the remediated procedure.

checklist.step: Roll up the control matrix status for the annual ICFR assertion
actions: Aggregate the year's walkthrough results, deficiencies and remediation status by control.
Draft the ICFR effectiveness assertion covering the WYO financial reporting cycle for CFO sign-off.
Attach the control matrix, evidence index and open-item list as supporting schedules.
checklist.done: a CFO-signed ICFR effectiveness assertion exists for the WYO financial reporting cycle, supported by the year's control matrix evidence.

checklist.step: Brief the Audit Committee on control effectiveness
actions: Prepare a one-page summary of control testing coverage, deficiency count by severity, and remediation status for the WYO reporting cycle.
Present the summary at the next scheduled Audit Committee session.
Record committee questions and any directed follow-up action in the meeting minutes.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has received and minuted the control effectiveness summary for the period.

checklist.step: Retain the control evidence for the required period
actions: Move the year's control matrix, monthly evidence packets and deficiency log into the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year.
Apply the 7-year retention label per the WYO Financial Assistance/Subsidy Arrangement records/access clause.
Confirm the repository index is searchable by control id and by month.
checklist.done: the year's control evidence is filed, labelled for 7-year retention and searchable by control id and month.

checklist.step: Update the procedure for any FEMA Financial Control Plan bulletin
actions: Monitor FEMA/BSA bulletins for changes to the output-tape layout, error codes or submission cadence.
Redline the Monthly Financial Reporting Control Procedure against the bulletin and route it for CFO re-approval.
Communicate the change to the Accountant and Senior Accountant performing the monthly cycle before it takes effect.
checklist.done: the procedure reflects the latest bulletin, is re-approved by the CFO, and performers were briefed before the next monthly cycle.

checklist.step: Confirm continued WYO Program authorization to write
actions: Verify the current fiscal year's TRRP pass status is on file before the WYO Financial Assistance/Subsidy Arrangement renewal date.
Where any monthly cycle failed TRRP zero-error tolerance, confirm the cure was accepted by the BSA before the renewal date.
Attach the TRRP pass evidence to the Arrangement renewal package sent to the CFO and General Counsel.
checklist.done: TRRP pass evidence for the fiscal year is attached to the Arrangement renewal package before the renewal deadline.

testing.step: Build the population of monthly reporting cycles for the fiscal year
actions: Extract from SAP S/4HANA the list of monthly WYO output-tape submissions and reconciliations for every writing company/NAIC co-code in the fiscal year.
Reconcile the count of monthly cycles to the filing tracker in the Internal Regulatory System — 12 per company with no gaps.
Resolve any missing or duplicate cycle before sampling begins.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to the filing tracker with no gaps or duplicates.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of months with a logged TRRP rejection or a reconciliation break over $1,000.
Take 4 additional months at random (seeded, reproducible) per writing company from the remaining population.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible and covers every month with a logged rejection or material break.

testing.step: Re-perform the GL-to-tape reconciliation for the sample
actions: Open the BlackLine reconciliation task for each sampled month and independently re-tie tape totals to the GL trial balance.
Recompute any reclass or true-up entry booked during the cycle and confirm it clears to zero.
Flag any difference between the re-performance and the filed reconciliation as an exception.
testing.done: each sampled month is independently re-tied with differences flagged as exceptions.

testing.step: Confirm TRRP error resolution on the sample
actions: Pull the TRRP error log for each sampled month and match each logged code to its source-transaction fix.
Confirm the corrected transaction, not just the tape file, was updated in SAP S/4HANA or the policy administration system.
Confirm the re-submitted tape achieved a clean pre-edit check before transmission.
testing.done: every logged TRRP error in the sample traces to a source-transaction fix and a clean re-submission.

testing.step: Trace each sampled submission to BSA acceptance
actions: In the Internal Regulatory System filing tracker, open the sampled month's submission record.
Confirm a BSA transmission confirmation number and a clean BSA acceptance report exist for the month.
For any rejection, confirm the cure was submitted and accepted inside the BSA cure window.
Capture the acceptance report into the workpaper.
testing.done: every sampled month traces to a captured BSA acceptance report, with cures shown inside the cure window.

testing.step: Re-perform the control walkthrough on a sub-sample
actions: Select 5 controls from the control matrix and re-perform each against the sampled month's evidence packet.
Interview the control owner where the re-performance does not match the documented procedure.
Note any design gap separately from a one-off execution error.
testing.done: the sub-sample of controls is independently re-performed with design gaps separated from execution errors.

testing.step: Verify the retention labelling on the sampled evidence
actions: Open the compliance evidence repository entry for each sampled month.
Confirm the 7-year retention label is applied and the packet is searchable by control id and month.
Flag any missing or mislabelled packet as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled month's evidence packet is retention-labelled and searchable, or flagged as an exception.

testing.step: Recompute the deadline maths against the BSA cycle calendar
actions: For each sampled month, recompute the BSA cycle close date from the published BSA calendar.
Compare the recomputed date to the actual transmission timestamp on the filing tracker.
Note any submission transmitted after the cycle close date as a timeliness exception, independent of any content exception.
testing.done: every sampled month's transmission timing is recomputed and compared to the BSA cycle calendar.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the month, company, what was missed and the affected control.
Assign a root cause and an owner, and set a remediation date.
Carry every open exception into the next quarter's walkthrough as a mandatory retest item.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and a mandatory retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate and compare it to the zero-tolerance threshold for TRRP errors and the $1,000 reconciliation threshold.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have an independent reviewer who performed none of the sampled re-performances sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion and any open deficiencies to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate exists, and results are reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Build the annual claims-compliance test plan
actions: In AuditBoard create the annual audit entry for NFIP Claims Manual compliance testing and set the scope to every writing company's flood claims.

Read the current NFIP Claims Manual (June 2025) table of contents and any claims guidance bulletins issued since the last cycle, and list the standards to be tested (coverage determination, ACV/RCV, proof-of-loss handling, appeals).
Set the test-cycle timeline, sample size targets and the 60-day closure deadline in the AuditBoard project plan.
Route the plan to the Chief Claims Officer for review and comment before kickoff.
checklist.done: an AuditBoard audit entry exists with scope, standards list, timeline and Chief Claims Officer review comments recorded.

checklist.step: Pull the closed-claims register for the test period
checklist.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: In the claims platform open the closed-claims report and filter Line of Business = Flood/SFIP and Close Date within the test period.
Export claim number, adjuster, coverage determination, ACV/RCV basis, reserve history and paid amount for every record.
Reconcile the exported count to the claims platform's summary dashboard for the same filters.
Save the register into the audit workpaper folder.
checklist.done: the closed-claims register is exported, reconciled to the platform dashboard, and filed in the workpaper folder.

checklist.step: Draw the annual sample
actions: Stratify the register by claim size and coverage determination type (paid in full, denied, partial, appealed).
Select a random (seeded, reproducible) sample from each stratum, weighting toward large-loss and denied claims.
Add 100% of claims already flagged by claims quality assurance review during the period.
Record the seed, population size and stratum counts in the workpaper.
checklist.done: a stratified, reproducible sample is drawn covering every stratum and all claims quality assurance flags.

checklist.step: Re-adjudicate coverage determination on each sampled claim
checklist.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: Open the claim file in the claims platform and read the policy declarations, the loss report and the adjuster's coverage notes.
Independently determine coverage against the current SFIP Homeowner Flood Form language without first reading the adjuster's conclusion.
Compare your determination to the filed determination and note any difference on the sample worksheet.
Cite the specific Claims Manual chapter and page relied on for the determination.
checklist.done: each sampled claim has an independent coverage re-determination with a cited Claims Manual reference.

checklist.step: Re-perform the ACV/RCV and payment calculation
actions: Recompute actual cash value or replacement cost value using the same estimating basis (Xactimate/CCC line items) recorded on the claim.
Compare the recomputed figure to the paid amount on the register and flag any variance over 5%.
Confirm depreciation and deductible were applied per the Claims Manual's stated methodology.
Note the variance reason (data entry, judgement call, Claims Manual deviation) on the worksheet.
checklist.done: each sampled claim's payment calculation is recomputed and any variance over 5% is reasoned and noted.

checklist.step: Test proof-of-loss and documentation completeness
actions: Confirm a signed proof of loss (or the file's documented basis for waiver) exists in the claim file for each sampled claim.
Confirm photos, the adjuster's inspection report and any engineering/elevation certificate referenced in the file are attached.
Flag any claim missing required documentation as a documentation exception, separate from a coverage or payment exception.
checklist.done: documentation completeness is confirmed or exceptioned for every sampled claim.

checklist.step: Interview the adjuster on flagged claims
actions: For every claim where re-adjudication disagrees with the filed determination, interview the adjuster who worked it.
Document the adjuster's stated rationale and compare it against the Claims Manual chapter cited.
Determine whether the disagreement is a genuine Claims Manual inconsistency or a documentation gap.
checklist.done: every disagreement is interviewed and classified as a Claims Manual inconsistency or a documentation gap.

checklist.step: Log every confirmed inconsistency as a finding
actions: Raise a tracker finding per confirmed inconsistency with claim number, the Claims Manual section violated and the reimbursement impact.
Rate severity by dollar impact and by whether the claim is subject to NFIP reversal/non-reimbursement.
Assign the finding to the responsible claims team lead with a remediation date.
checklist.done: every confirmed inconsistency is logged as a rated finding with an owner and remediation date.

checklist.step: Build and approve the remediation plan
actions: For each finding, define the corrective action: re-adjudicate and pay the correct amount, retrain the adjuster, or update the claims procedure.
Set a remediation date for each action and confirm the Claims Quality Assurance / Training Manager will retest.
Sign the remediation plan before it goes back to Internal Audit for tracking.
checklist.done: a signed remediation plan with corrective actions and dates exists for every finding.

checklist.step: Retrain adjusters on Claims Manual gaps surfaced by the test
actions: Build a targeted training module covering the specific Claims Manual sections that generated findings.
Deliver the training to the affected adjuster team and record attendance.
Re-review 5 of that adjuster's subsequent claims within 30 days to confirm the correction stuck.
checklist.done: targeted training is delivered with attendance recorded, and a 30-day post-training re-review is completed.

checklist.step: Retest closed findings before sign-off
actions: Pull the corrected claim file or the next-cycle claims for the same adjuster/issue.
Confirm the corrective action was actually applied, not just documented as planned.
Close the tracker finding only when the retest passes.
checklist.done: every finding is retested and closed only after the retest confirms the correction.

checklist.step: Assess whether any reversed/non-reimbursed claim requires a self-report
actions: Review findings that resulted in claim reversal or non-reimbursement risk under the WYO Arrangement.
Determine whether the pattern requires proactive disclosure to the NFIP Bureau and Statistical Agent.
Document the self-report decision and rationale, with sign-off from the Chief Audit Executive.
checklist.done: a documented, signed self-report decision exists for any finding carrying reversal/non-reimbursement risk.

checklist.step: Roll up the annual test results for the Audit Committee
actions: Summarize sample size, exception rate, findings by severity and remediation status.
Compare the exception rate to the 2% expanded-sample threshold and note whether it was triggered.
Present the summary at the next Audit Committee session and record minutes.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has received and minuted the annual claims-compliance test summary.

checklist.step: Update the claims procedures library for confirmed gaps
actions: Redline the internal claims adjustment procedure for every confirmed Claims Manual inconsistency.
Route the redline for Chief Claims Officer approval and publish the updated procedure to the adjuster team.
Record the effective date of the procedure update.
checklist.done: the claims procedure is updated, approved and published with an effective date for every confirmed gap.

checklist.step: Retain the test evidence for the required period
actions: Move the test plan, sample worksheets, interview notes and remediation log into the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year.
Apply the 7-year retention label and confirm the repository index is searchable by claim number.
Close out the AuditBoard project entry with a final status.
checklist.done: the test evidence is filed, retention-labelled, searchable by claim number, and the AuditBoard entry is closed.

testing.step: Build the population of closed flood claims for the fiscal year
testing.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: Extract the closed-claims report for Line of Business = Flood/SFIP for the full fiscal year across every writing company.
Reconcile the extract count to the finance closed-claims summary for the same period.
Resolve any count difference before sampling.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to the finance summary with no unresolved differences.

testing.step: Select the independent test sample
actions: Stratify the population by claim size and determination type independently of Claims Quality Assurance's own sample.
Draw a random (seeded, reproducible) sample of at least 40 claims, including 100% of the prior test's open findings.
Record the seed and stratum counts in the workpaper.
testing.done: an independent, reproducible sample of at least 40 claims is drawn, including all prior-cycle open findings.

testing.step: Independently re-adjudicate coverage on the sample
testing.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: Open each sampled claim without reading the original test's conclusion first.
Determine coverage against the current SFIP Homeowner Flood Form and cite the Claims Manual chapter relied on.
Compare to both the original adjuster's determination and the first-line test's conclusion, flagging any three-way disagreement.
testing.done: each sampled claim carries an independent coverage determination compared against both prior conclusions.

testing.step: Recompute ACV/RCV and payment for the sample
actions: Recompute the payment using the estimating line items in the claim file, independent of the first-line recompute.
Compare to the paid amount and to the first-line test's recomputed figure; flag any variance over 5%.
Document the estimating basis used for the recompute.
testing.done: payment is independently recomputed for the sample with variances over 5% flagged and documented.

testing.step: Trace documentation completeness on the sample
actions: Confirm proof of loss, inspection report and supporting photos/engineering reports are present in each sampled file.
Confirm any waiver of proof of loss is itself documented and Claims Manual-compliant.
Log missing documentation as a distinct exception category.
testing.done: documentation completeness is independently confirmed or exceptioned for the sample.

testing.step: Verify finding disposition and remediation for prior-cycle exceptions
actions: Pull every open finding from the prior test cycle from the issue tracker.
Confirm the remediation plan was executed and the retraining/re-adjudication actually occurred.
Re-test a sample of the affected adjuster's subsequent claims to confirm the correction held.
testing.done: prior-cycle findings are confirmed remediated or re-flagged as still open.

testing.step: Verify the self-report assessment for reversal-risk findings
actions: Pull the Regulatory Counsel self-report decision memo for any finding carrying reversal/non-reimbursement risk.
Confirm the decision rationale is documented and signed by the Chief Audit Executive.
Flag any reversal-risk finding lacking a documented decision as an exception.
testing.done: every reversal-risk finding has a documented, signed self-report decision or is flagged as an exception.

testing.step: Recompute the exception rate against the pass/fail threshold
actions: Compute the exception rate across coverage, payment and documentation categories for the independent sample.
Compare to the 2% expanded-sample threshold; if exceeded, pull an additional 20-claim sample from the same population.
Document the expansion decision and its results if triggered.
testing.done: the exception rate is computed and, if over threshold, an expanded sample is drawn and documented.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception distinct from any first-line finding it corroborates or contradicts.
Assign a root cause and an owner, and set a remediation date.
Carry unresolved exceptions into the next quarter's interim pull as mandatory retest items.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references from the independent sample.
Have a reviewer segregated from the sample re-performance sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion, exception rate and any self-report decisions to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in AuditBoard.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion exists and results are reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Issue the independence questionnaire to the audit firm
actions: Send the firm's engagement partner the current-year independence questionnaire covering financial interests, non-audit services performed and family relationships with company officers.
Set a 10-business-day response deadline and log the send date in AuditBoard.
Follow up with the engagement partner if the questionnaire is not returned within the deadline.
checklist.done: the questionnaire is sent with a logged deadline and follows up if not returned on time.

checklist.step: Verify lead and concurring partner rotation
actions: Pull the partner-rotation schedule the firm maintains and confirm the lead and concurring partner tenure on this engagement.
Compare tenure to the applicable rotation limit and flag any partner approaching or past the limit.
Request the firm's succession plan for any partner within one year of the rotation limit.
checklist.done: partner tenure is verified against the rotation limit with a succession plan on file for any partner near the limit.

checklist.step: Review non-audit services for independence impairment
actions: List every non-audit service the firm or its network performed for the company in the prior 12 months.
Assess each service against the independence rules that apply to the audit engagement.
Flag any service requiring pre-approval that was not pre-approved by the Audit Committee.
checklist.done: every non-audit service is listed, assessed and any pre-approval gap is flagged.

checklist.step: Obtain Audit Committee pre-approval for planned non-audit services
actions: Present the firm's proposed non-audit services for the coming year to the Audit Committee.
Record the committee's approval or denial of each proposed service in the minutes.
Communicate any denial to the audit firm before the service is performed.
checklist.done: Audit Committee approval or denial is recorded in minutes for every proposed non-audit service before it is performed.

checklist.step: Confirm the engagement letter reflects the verified independence status
actions: Review the draft engagement letter against the questionnaire results and rotation schedule.
Confirm the letter's scope excludes any service the Audit Committee denied.
Route the letter for Audit Committee chair countersignature only after independence is confirmed.
checklist.done: the engagement letter is reviewed against verified independence status before it is routed for countersignature.

checklist.step: Present the independence findings to the Audit Committee
actions: Summarize the questionnaire results, rotation status and any flagged impairment for the committee.
Have the committee formally reaffirm auditor independence before the engagement letter is signed.
Record the reaffirmation in the meeting minutes.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has formally reaffirmed independence and it is recorded in minutes.

checklist.step: Countersign and file the engagement letter
actions: Route the finalized engagement letter for Audit Committee chair signature via DocuSign.
File the countersigned letter in the AuditBoard entry alongside the independence questionnaire and rotation schedule.
Notify the Controller that fieldwork may begin only after the letter is fully executed.
checklist.done: the engagement letter is countersigned, filed with supporting evidence, and fieldwork clearance is communicated.

checklist.step: Log any independence impairment as an exception
actions: Raise a tracker issue for any impairment or missed rotation identified during verification.
Document the remediation taken (partner change, service withdrawal, engagement delay) and its date.
Route the issue to the Chief Audit Executive for sign-off before closure.
checklist.done: every impairment is logged with a documented remediation and Chief Audit Executive sign-off.

checklist.step: Monitor independence through the audit cycle
actions: Require the engagement partner to disclose any new non-audit service request or personnel change mid-cycle.
Re-assess independence against any disclosed change within 5 business days.
Escalate any new impairment to the Chief Audit Executive immediately.
checklist.done: mid-cycle disclosures are re-assessed within 5 business days and any new impairment is escalated immediately.

checklist.step: Track the multi-year rotation calendar
actions: Maintain a forward rotation calendar showing each partner's expected rotation year.
Flag any upcoming rotation to the Chief Audit Executive 12 months ahead of the limit.
Update the calendar immediately when a firm notifies of a partner change.
checklist.done: a forward rotation calendar exists with 12-month advance flags and is kept current on firm notifications.

checklist.step: Reconcile the audit fee to the pre-approved scope
actions: Compare the invoiced audit and non-audit fees to the amounts and scope the Audit Committee pre-approved.
Flag any fee or scope overrun to the Chief Audit Executive before payment.
Document the resolution of any flagged overrun.
checklist.done: invoiced fees are reconciled to pre-approved scope with any overrun flagged and resolved before payment.

checklist.step: Communicate the verification result to the audit firm
actions: Send the audit firm written confirmation that independence and rotation verification is complete for the engagement year.
Note any condition attached to the confirmation (e.g., a service restriction).
File the confirmation with the engagement letter.
checklist.done: written confirmation of verification completion is sent to the firm and filed with the engagement letter.

checklist.step: Refresh the procedure for any FEMA or professional-standards change
actions: Monitor for changes to applicable independence/rotation standards or FEMA Financial Control Plan audit provisions.
Redline the verification procedure and route for Audit Committee approval.
Communicate the updated procedure to Internal Audit and Regulatory Counsel before the next engagement cycle.
checklist.done: the procedure is updated, Audit Committee-approved and communicated before the next engagement cycle.

checklist.step: Retain the independence evidence for the required period
actions: Move the questionnaire, rotation schedule, non-audit service log and Audit Committee minutes into the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the 7-year retention label and confirm the record is searchable by engagement year.
Close the AuditBoard entry with a final status.
checklist.done: the independence evidence is filed, retention-labelled, searchable by engagement year, and the AuditBoard entry is closed.

testing.step: Build the population of audit engagements to test
actions: Pull every external audit and non-audit engagement letter from AuditBoard for the prior three years.
Reconcile the count to the Audit Committee minutes approving each engagement.
Resolve any unreconciled engagement before sampling.
testing.done: the engagement population is reconciled to Audit Committee minutes with no gaps.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of engagements within two years of a partner rotation limit.
Take all non-audit service engagements from the prior 12 months.
Record the population and selection rationale in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample covers 100% of near-limit rotations and all recent non-audit engagements, documented in the workpaper.

testing.step: Independently re-verify partner tenure
actions: Request the firm's independent quality-control confirmation of lead and concurring partner tenure for each sampled engagement.
Compare to the tenure recorded in the internal rotation calendar.
Flag any discrepancy as an exception.
testing.done: partner tenure is independently confirmed by the firm and reconciled to the internal calendar.

testing.step: Re-assess non-audit service independence impact
actions: Re-read each sampled non-audit service against the independence rules without referencing the original assessment.
Confirm Audit Committee pre-approval exists and pre-dates the service performance.
Flag any service performed before pre-approval was granted as a fail, not a documentation gap.
testing.done: each sampled non-audit service is independently re-assessed with pre-approval timing confirmed.

testing.step: Confirm the independence questionnaire was fully completed and signed
actions: Open each sampled engagement's questionnaire and confirm every question is answered, not left blank.
Confirm the engagement partner's signature and date are present.
Flag incomplete questionnaires as an exception regardless of the substantive answers given.
testing.done: questionnaire completeness and signature are confirmed for every sampled engagement.

testing.step: Verify Audit Committee reaffirmation minutes
actions: Pull the committee minutes for each sampled engagement year and confirm a formal independence reaffirmation is recorded.
Confirm the reaffirmation date pre-dates the engagement letter countersignature.
Flag any engagement letter signed before reaffirmation as a fail.
testing.done: reaffirmation minutes are verified to pre-date the engagement letter for every sampled engagement.

testing.step: Recompute fee reconciliation against pre-approved scope
actions: Pull invoiced audit and non-audit fees from the general ledger for each sampled engagement.
Compare to the Audit Committee pre-approved fee/scope on file.
Flag any overrun not separately re-approved.
testing.done: fees are recomputed and compared to pre-approved scope with unresolved overruns flagged.

testing.step: Trace exception disclosures to remediation
actions: Pull every impairment or rotation exception logged during the period.
Confirm the documented remediation (partner change, service withdrawal) actually occurred before the next engagement milestone.
Flag any remediation that was only planned, not executed, as still open.
testing.done: logged exceptions are traced to executed remediation or flagged as still open.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the engagement, what failed and the independence rule implicated.
Assign a root cause and an owner, and set a remediation date.
Carry unresolved exceptions into the next engagement's verification as mandatory checks.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and carry-forward commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Write the conclusion (independence maintained / maintained with exceptions / impaired) with evidence references.
Have an independent reviewer who did not perform the sample re-verification sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in AuditBoard.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion exists and results are reported to the Audit Committee.

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — WYO Financial Assistance/Subsidy Arrangement Art. III.C (ULAE/ALAE reimbursement) and the audited-statement filing requirement of the current Financial Control Plan, re-read each filing cycle (rep jurisdiction: FEMA NFIP)

In-scope processes.value: Year-end close, external audit fieldwork, and filing of the audited annual financial statements and management/auditor communication letters with the BSA

In-scope systems.value: Audited statement package, management representation letter and auditor communication letters

Compliance procedure documented.value: Annual Audited Statement Filing Procedure — close, audit fieldwork support, statement finalization, BSA filing and communications retention

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the CFO; reviewed annually before year-end close kicks off

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Annual — audited statements and auditor communications due to the BSA per the Financial Control Plan filing calendar, generally within 90 days of fiscal year end

Deadline reminders configured.value: Close/consolidation tool alerts at fiscal year end plus 30/60/75 days counting toward the 90-day BSA filing deadline

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Audited statements, management representation letter, auditor communication letters and BSA filing confirmation retained 7 years per the WYO Arrangement records/access clause

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any late or incomplete filing is logged with the cause and the corrective filing date

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Controller signs off any late-filing remediation and confirms BSA acceptance before closing the exception

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: All annual audited statement filings and auditor communication letters filed with the BSA in the prior three fiscal years

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Any filing submitted after the 90-day deadline, or any communication letter missing from the BSA package, is a fail

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Obligation is annual; test performed once per fiscal year immediately following each filing

Evidence location for test results.value: Annual filing-verification workpaper in the compliance evidence repository, cross-referenced to the financial reporting repository

Regulator response path.value: Controller owns the BSA response; CFO clears any restatement or late-filing disclosure before it is sent

checklist.step: Kick off the year-end close for the WYO audited statement cycle
actions: In BlackLine open the year-end close task list and add the WYO audited-statement filing milestone with its 90-day BSA deadline.
Assign close tasks (trial balance lock, reserve certification, intercompany eliminations) to the Senior Accountant and Accountant with due dates that leave time for audit fieldwork.
Confirm the fiscal year end trial balance is locked in SAP S/4HANA before fieldwork begins.
checklist.done: the close task list is built with the BSA deadline milestone and the trial balance is locked before fieldwork starts.

checklist.step: Support external audit fieldwork with the PBC (prepared-by-client) list
actions: Build the PBC list from the audit firm's request and assign each item an internal owner and due date.
Deliver supporting schedules (reserve rollforwards, premium and loss detail, reinsurance recoverables) to the audit team by the agreed dates.
Log every PBC item's delivery date and the audit team's follow-up questions.
checklist.done: every PBC item is delivered by its due date with follow-up questions logged.

checklist.step: Draft the management representation letter
actions: Draft the representation letter using the audit firm's template, addressing WYO-specific representations (Claims Manual compliance, TRRP status, reinsurance recoverables).
Route the draft to the CFO and General Counsel for review before signature.
Sign and deliver the letter to the audit firm ahead of report issuance.
checklist.done: a CFO- and General Counsel-reviewed management representation letter is signed and delivered before report issuance.

checklist.step: Finalize the audited annual financial statements
actions: Incorporate the audit firm's final adjustments into the statement package in the financial reporting repository.
Confirm the statements tie to the year-end trial balance and the WYO monthly output tape totals for the fiscal year.
Obtain CFO sign-off on the finalized statement package.
checklist.done: the finalized, CFO-signed statement package ties to the trial balance and the year's output tape totals.

checklist.step: Collect the auditor communication letters
actions: Request from the audit firm the required communication letters (report on internal control matters, communication with those charged with governance, any management letter).
Confirm each letter is dated on or before the audit report date.
File the letters alongside the statement package in the financial reporting repository.
checklist.done: all required auditor communication letters are collected, correctly dated and filed with the statement package.

checklist.step: Assemble the BSA filing package
actions: Combine the audited statements, management representation letter and auditor communication letters into the BSA-prescribed package format.
Check the package against the Financial Control Plan's filing checklist for completeness.
Route the assembled package to the Controller for final release approval.
checklist.done: the package is assembled to the Financial Control Plan checklist and approved for release by the Controller.

checklist.step: File the package with the NFIP Bureau and Statistical Agent
actions: Log the package into the Internal Regulatory System's WYO annual filing tracker.
Transmit the package to the BSA through the designated NFIP annual filing channel before the 90-day deadline.
Record the transmission confirmation number and timestamp on the tracker entry.
checklist.done: the package is transmitted before the 90-day deadline with a confirmation number recorded in the tracker.

checklist.step: Confirm BSA receipt and completeness acknowledgement
actions: Check the BSA acknowledgement report against the transmitted package for completeness.
Resolve any request for a missing exhibit or clarification within the BSA's stated response window.
Update the filing tracker to Accepted once the BSA confirms completeness.
checklist.done: the filing tracker shows Accepted with a completeness acknowledgement from the BSA.

checklist.step: Distribute the filed statements internally
actions: Share the final filed package with the CFO, Chief Audit Executive and Board Governance Lead.
Note any audit adjustment or communication-letter matter that requires Board or Audit Committee attention.
Confirm receipt from each recipient.
checklist.done: the filed package is distributed to CFO, Chief Audit Executive and Board Governance Lead with receipt confirmed.

checklist.step: Escalate any deadline-at-risk situation
actions: Monitor close and audit-fieldwork progress against the 90-day BSA deadline weekly during the filing cycle.
Where the deadline is at risk, escalate to the CFO within one business day with the cause and a recovery plan.
Where a filing extension is available under the Financial Control Plan, request it in writing before the deadline passes.
checklist.done: any at-risk deadline is escalated within one business day with a recovery plan or a written extension request filed before the deadline.

checklist.step: Log any late or incomplete filing as an exception
actions: Raise a tracker issue for any filing submitted after the deadline or returned incomplete by the BSA.
Document the root cause and the corrective filing date.
Route the issue to the Controller for sign-off before closure.
checklist.done: every late or incomplete filing is logged with a root cause and Controller-signed corrective filing date.

checklist.step: Reconcile ULAE/ALAE reimbursement claims to the filed statements
actions: Compare the ULAE/ALAE reimbursement amounts claimed under WYO Arrangement Art. III.C to the figures in the filed audited statements.
Resolve any discrepancy with the Controller before the reimbursement claim is submitted.
File the reconciliation with the annual filing package.
checklist.done: ULAE/ALAE reimbursement figures are reconciled to the filed statements and any discrepancy is resolved before submission.

checklist.step: Present the filing outcome to the Audit Committee
actions: Summarize filing timeliness, audit adjustments and any communication-letter matters for the committee.
Present at the next scheduled Audit Committee session and record minutes.
Note any directed follow-up action.
checklist.done: the Audit Committee has received and minuted the annual filing outcome summary.

checklist.step: Update the filing procedure for any Financial Control Plan change
actions: Monitor FEMA/BSA bulletins for changes to the audited-statement filing format or deadline.
Redline the filing procedure and route it for CFO re-approval before the next cycle.
Communicate the change to the close team and the audit firm liaison.
checklist.done: the procedure reflects the latest bulletin, is CFO re-approved, and the team is briefed before the next cycle.

checklist.step: Retain the filing evidence for the required period
actions: Move the statement package, representation letter, communication letters and BSA confirmation into the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year.
Apply the 7-year retention label per the WYO Arrangement records/access clause.
Confirm the repository index is searchable by fiscal year.
checklist.done: the filing evidence is filed, retention-labelled and searchable by fiscal year.

testing.step: Build the population of annual filings to test
actions: Pull the WYO annual filing tracker for the prior three fiscal years across every writing company.
Reconcile the count to the financial reporting repository's statement package index.
Resolve any unreconciled filing before sampling.
testing.done: the population is reconciled between the filing tracker and the reporting repository.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of filings flagged late or incomplete by the BSA.
Take one additional fiscal year at random per writing company from the remaining population.
Record the seed and population size in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample covers all flagged filings plus a random additional year per company, documented in the workpaper.

testing.step: Recompute filing timeliness against the 90-day deadline
actions: Recompute the 90-day deadline from each sampled fiscal year end.
Compare to the actual BSA transmission timestamp on the filing tracker.
Flag any filing transmitted after the recomputed deadline as an exception.
testing.done: filing timeliness is independently recomputed and compared for every sampled filing.

testing.step: Verify package completeness against the Financial Control Plan checklist
actions: Open each sampled package and check it against the current Financial Control Plan filing checklist item by item.
Confirm every required communication letter is present and correctly dated.
Flag any missing or mis-dated item as an exception.
testing.done: package completeness is independently checked against the current checklist for every sampled filing.

testing.step: Re-tie the filed statements to the trial balance and output tape totals
actions: Pull the year-end trial balance from SAP S/4HANA for each sampled fiscal year.
Tie the filed audited statement totals to the trial balance and to the sum of the year's monthly output tapes.
Flag any untied difference as an exception.
testing.done: filed statement totals are independently re-tied to the trial balance and output tapes for every sampled year.

testing.step: Confirm the management representation letter timing
actions: Confirm the representation letter is signed and dated on or before the audit report date for each sampled year.
Confirm CFO and General Counsel review is evidenced before signature.
Flag any late-signed or unreviewed letter as an exception.
testing.done: representation letter timing and review are confirmed for every sampled year.

testing.step: Trace exception disclosures to remediation
actions: Pull every late or incomplete filing exception logged in the tracker for the sample period.
Confirm the corrective filing date recorded actually resolved the BSA's completeness request.
Flag any exception without a confirmed resolution as still open.
testing.done: logged exceptions are traced to confirmed resolution or flagged as still open.

testing.step: Recompute the ULAE/ALAE reconciliation on the sample
actions: Independently recompute the ULAE/ALAE reimbursement figures from the filed statements for each sampled year.
Compare to the amount actually claimed under WYO Arrangement Art. III.C.
Flag any unreconciled difference as an exception.
testing.done: ULAE/ALAE figures are independently recomputed and compared for every sampled year.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the fiscal year, what failed and the filing impact.
Assign a root cause and an owner, and set a remediation date.
Carry unresolved exceptions into the next annual filing cycle as mandatory pre-checks.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and carry-forward commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate and compare to the zero-late-filing threshold.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have an independent reviewer who performed none of the sampled re-performance sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion exists and results are reported to the Audit Committee.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns monitoring for declared flood catastrophes and activating the accelerated NFIP Bureau and Statistical Agent data-call cadence

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — 44 CFR 62.23(i), (j)(3) and the current WYO Financial Control Plan catastrophe claims reporting provisions, re-read at the start of each hurricane/flood season (rep jurisdiction: FEMA NFIP)

In-scope processes.value: Catastrophe declaration monitoring, data-call activation and cadence tracking for every declared flood event affecting NFIP-insured risks

In-scope systems.value: Catastrophe declaration feed cross-referenced against Moody's RMS event footprints and the claims platform's flood exposure by ZIP/county

Compliance procedure documented.value: Catastrophe Data Call Monitoring Procedure — declaration monitoring, cadence activation, calendar build and reporting-team handoff

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Head of Compliance; reviewed annually before hurricane season and after any FEMA cadence bulletin

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Event-driven — the accelerated reporting cadence FEMA directs following declaration, tracked from the declaration date until the BSA stands down the event

Deadline reminders configured.value: Regulatory reporting calendar alert within 24 hours of any FEMA flood catastrophe declaration affecting an in-force NFIP book

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Data call calendar, declaration notices and cadence-activation records retained 7 years per the WYO Arrangement records/access clause

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any missed or late-detected declaration is logged with the detection gap and the process fix

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Regulatory Reporting Manager signs off any detection-gap remediation before the next catastrophe season

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: All FEMA flood catastrophe declarations in the test period affecting a state or county where the company writes NFIP business

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Any declaration affecting in-force exposure not detected and logged within 24 hours is a fail

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Obligation is event-driven; monitoring effectiveness tested quarterly plus after every declared event

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Must not be the analyst who ran the original declaration monitoring for the sampled event

Evidence location for test results.value: Quarterly monitoring-effectiveness workpaper in the compliance evidence repository, cross-referenced to the data call calendar

checklist.step: Configure the catastrophe declaration monitoring feed
actions: In the Catastrophe Data Provider console, subscribe to FEMA major disaster declaration alerts filtered to flood/severe storm events.
Cross-configure the feed against Moody's RMS event footprint layers so declarations auto-flag against the company's in-force flood exposure by ZIP/county.
Route the alert output to the Regulatory Reporting distribution list and the Regulatory Reporting Manager.
checklist.done: the declaration feed is subscribed, cross-configured against exposure footprints, and routed to the reporting distribution list.

checklist.step: Confirm exposure overlap on every new declaration
checklist.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: On receipt of a declaration alert, query the claims platform for in-force SFIP policy counts in the declared counties.
Confirm whether the company has an active book in the affected area within 4 hours of the alert.
Log the exposure-confirmation result and timestamp on the data call calendar entry for the event.
checklist.done: exposure overlap is confirmed within 4 hours of every declaration and logged on the calendar entry.

checklist.step: Activate the accelerated reporting cadence
actions: Read the FEMA/BSA bulletin or Financial Control Plan section directing the cadence for the declared event type.
Set the reporting frequency (e.g., weekly or bi-weekly claim counts and loss estimates) on the data call calendar for the event.
Notify Claims Operations and Regulatory Reporting Analyst staff of the activated cadence and its first due date.
checklist.done: the cadence is set on the calendar per the FEMA bulletin and Claims Operations is notified of the first due date.

checklist.step: Open the event tracking folder
actions: Create an event folder in the compliance evidence repository named for the FEMA disaster declaration number.
File the declaration notice, exposure-confirmation log and cadence-activation record into the folder.
Link the folder to the data call calendar entry.
checklist.done: an event folder exists with declaration notice, exposure log and cadence record, linked to the calendar.

checklist.step: Coordinate the cat data-call handoff to Claims Operations
actions: Brief Claims Operations on the required data fields (claim counts, paid/incurred losses, reserve estimates) and the cadence deadline.
Confirm Claims Operations has the correct event peril code and declaration number to filter claims correctly.
Set the first cadence check-in meeting within 48 hours of activation.
checklist.done: Claims Operations is briefed with correct filters and a check-in meeting is set within 48 hours.

checklist.step: Monitor for cadence changes mid-event
actions: Watch for FEMA/BSA bulletins that escalate or de-escalate the reporting cadence as the event develops.
Update the data call calendar within 4 hours of any cadence change.
Notify Claims Operations of the revised cadence and next due date immediately.
checklist.done: cadence changes are reflected on the calendar within 4 hours and Claims Operations is notified immediately.

checklist.step: Track cadence compliance through the event lifecycle
actions: Check off each cadence deadline on the calendar as Claims Operations submits its data.
Follow up same-day on any deadline not met.
Escalate a repeated miss to the Head of Compliance.
checklist.done: every cadence deadline is tracked to completion with same-day follow-up on misses and escalation of repeats.

checklist.step: Confirm the BSA stand-down notice
actions: Watch for the FEMA/BSA notice ending the accelerated cadence for the event.
Confirm the final cadence submission was accepted before closing the event.
Update the data call calendar entry to Closed with the stand-down date.
checklist.done: the event calendar entry is closed with a confirmed stand-down date and a final accepted submission.

checklist.step: Log any missed or late-detected declaration
actions: Raise a tracker issue for any declaration not detected and logged within 24 hours.
Document the detection gap (feed lag, missed alert, misconfigured filter) and the fix applied.
Route to the Regulatory Reporting Manager for sign-off.
checklist.done: every missed or late detection is logged with a documented gap, fix and manager sign-off.

checklist.step: Run the pre-season monitoring readiness check
actions: Before each hurricane/flood season, test the declaration feed with a simulated alert and confirm it routes correctly.
Confirm the exposure-overlap query against the claims platform still returns correct results.
Refresh the Claims Operations contact list and escalation path.
checklist.done: a pre-season readiness test confirms the feed, exposure query and contact list are functioning correctly.

checklist.step: Reconcile the event's total submitted data to the claims platform
actions: At event closure, sum all cadence submissions for claim counts and paid/incurred losses.
Reconcile the sum to the claims platform's final event-tagged totals.
Document and resolve any difference before filing the closure record.
checklist.done: cumulative submitted totals are reconciled to the claims platform at event closure with differences resolved.

checklist.step: Brief leadership on event reporting performance
actions: Summarize detection time, cadence compliance and any missed deadlines for the event.
Present the summary to the Head of Compliance and Chief Risk Officer.
Record any directed process improvement.
checklist.done: leadership has received the event reporting performance summary with any directed improvement recorded.

checklist.step: Update the monitoring procedure for lessons learned
actions: Redline the Catastrophe Data Call Monitoring Procedure for any gap surfaced by the event.
Approve the updated procedure before the next season.
Communicate the change to Regulatory Reporting and Claims Operations.
checklist.done: the procedure is updated, approved and communicated before the next season.

checklist.step: Verify vendor feed reliability annually
actions: Review the Catastrophe Data Provider's uptime and alert-delivery record for the prior 12 months.
Raise any reliability concern with the vendor account team and document the response.
Confirm backup monitoring (manual FEMA.gov declaration check) is documented as a fallback.
checklist.done: vendor reliability is reviewed annually with a documented fallback monitoring method.

checklist.step: Retain the event monitoring evidence
actions: Confirm each closed event folder carries the 7-year retention label in the compliance evidence repository.
Confirm the folder is searchable by FEMA declaration number.
Archive the season's data call calendar into the repository.
checklist.done: closed event folders are retention-labelled, searchable by declaration number, and the season calendar is archived.

testing.step: Build the population of flood catastrophe declarations for the period
actions: Independently query FEMA's disaster declaration history for flood/severe storm events in the test period.
Cross-reference each declaration against the company's in-force book to identify events with genuine exposure overlap.
Reconcile this independent list to the company's data call calendar.
testing.done: an independently built declaration population is reconciled to the company's data call calendar.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of events where exposure overlap existed and detection took longer than 24 hours per company records.
Take 3 additional events at random from the reconciled population.
Record the seed and population size in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample covers all detection-gap events plus 3 random events, documented in the workpaper.

testing.step: Independently recompute the detection-time gap
actions: For each sampled event, record the FEMA declaration timestamp from the public declaration record.
Compare it to the exposure-confirmation timestamp logged on the company's data call calendar.
Flag any gap exceeding 24 hours as an exception.
testing.done: detection-time gaps are independently recomputed and flagged for every sampled event.

testing.step: Verify cadence activation matched the FEMA bulletin
actions: Re-read the FEMA/BSA bulletin for each sampled event's directed cadence.
Compare to the cadence actually set on the company's data call calendar.
Flag any mismatch in frequency or start date as an exception.
testing.done: cadence activation is independently verified against the bulletin for every sampled event.

testing.step: Trace cadence submissions to Claims Operations records
testing.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: Pull each sampled event's cadence submissions and trace the claim counts and loss figures to the claims platform's event-tagged data.
Confirm each submission was made on or before its calendar due date.
Flag any untraceable figure or late submission as an exception.
testing.done: cadence submissions are traced to claims platform data with timeliness confirmed for every sampled event.

testing.step: Recompute the reconciliation of cumulative submitted totals

checklist.step: Receive the activated data-call cadence and assign a compiler

Set the first submission deadline in the claims platform task list.
checklist.done: a compiler is assigned with the correct event identifiers and the first deadline is scheduled.

checklist.step: Extract the event-tagged claims data
checklist.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: In the claims platform open the catastrophe reporting query and filter by the FEMA declaration/event code.
Export claim counts, paid losses, case reserves and IBNR estimate by state and county.
Reconcile the export record count to the platform's event dashboard total.
checklist.done: the event-tagged extract is reconciled to the platform dashboard total before compilation continues.

checklist.step: Validate the extract for completeness and accuracy

Confirm no in-scope claim was excluded by an incorrect peril-code filter.
Correct any data-entry or filter error found and re-run the extract.
checklist.done: the extract passes the spot-check with any filter or data error corrected before submission.

checklist.step: Format and submit the data-call file
actions: Format the validated extract into the layout specified by the active FEMA cadence bulletin.
Log the file into the Internal Regulatory System's data-call tracker and transmit it before the cadence deadline.
Record the transmission confirmation and timestamp on the tracker entry.
checklist.done: the formatted file is transmitted before the deadline with a confirmation recorded in the tracker.

checklist.step: Confirm submission acceptance and clear rejections

Update the tracker to Accepted once confirmed.

checklist.step: Maintain the 3-year FIA operational review readiness calendar
actions: Track the date of the last completed FIA operational review and calculate the next mandatory review window.
Confirm underwriting, claims and financial operations records are indexed and retrievable ahead of the window.
Brief the Chief Claims Officer annually on readiness status.
checklist.done: the 3-year review calendar is maintained and readiness is briefed to the Chief Claims Officer annually.

checklist.step: Receive and log the FIA operational review notice
actions: On receipt of a review notice, log the review scope, start date and the FIA review team's initial record request list.
Assign an internal liaison to coordinate all record production and system/staff access requests.
Confirm the review timeline with General Counsel before access is provisioned.
checklist.done: the review is logged, a liaison is assigned, and the timeline is confirmed with General Counsel.

checklist.step: Provision system and record access for the review team
checklist.app: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
actions: Request read-only reviewer access to the claims platform and underwriting/financial systems from IT Security, scoped to the review's stated data.
Confirm access is provisioned before the review's on-site or remote start date.
Log every system granted and the access-expiry date tied to the review's end date.
checklist.done: scoped, time-boxed reviewer access is provisioned before the review start date and logged.

checklist.step: Produce records against the FIA request list

Pull the requested claim files, underwriting files or financial schedules from the source system and deliver them within the reviewer's stated window.
Log the delivery date and reviewer acknowledgement for each item.
checklist.done: every FIA record request is logged, produced and acknowledged within the reviewer's stated window.

checklist.step: Make staff available for FIA interviews

Brief interviewees on the review's scope and remind them to answer factually from the record.
Log interview dates and attendees.
checklist.done: requested staff interviews are scheduled within the review timeline and logged.

checklist.step: Track open review items to closure

Follow up daily during the active review period on any item past its due date.
Confirm the FIA review team marks each item resolved before it is removed from the list.
checklist.done: the open-items list is actively tracked with reviewer confirmation before any item is closed.

checklist.step: Revoke reviewer access at review close
actions: Confirm the review's end date with the FIA review lead.
Request IT Security revoke all reviewer system access on or before that date.
Log the revocation confirmation.
checklist.done: reviewer access is revoked on or before the confirmed review end date, with revocation logged.

checklist.step: Log any missed data-call deadline or access-provisioning gap

Document the root cause and the corrective action taken.
Route to the Claims Director / Manager for sign-off.
checklist.done: every missed deadline or access gap is logged with a documented cause and manager sign-off.

checklist.step: Respond to any FIA operational review findings

checklist.done: a remediation plan is built and submitted to FEMA within the report's specified timeframe.

Archive the readiness calendar and open-items list.
checklist.done: data-call and review evidence is filed, retention-labelled and searchable by event and review year.

Reconcile counts to the claims platform extraction logs and resolve any gap before sampling.
testing.done: the population is reconciled to source extraction logs with no unresolved gaps.

testing.done: each sampled submission's figures are independently re-extracted and compared, with variances explained.

testing.step: Recompute submission timeliness against the cadence deadline

Flag any submission after the deadline as an exception.
testing.done: timeliness is independently recomputed and compared for every sampled submission.

testing.step: Verify FIA record-production timeliness on the sample

Flag any late or unacknowledged delivery as an exception.
testing.done: FIA record-production timeliness is independently verified for the sample with acknowledgements confirmed.

Confirm access was scoped to the review data and revoked on or before the logged review end date.
Flag any access left open past the review end date as an exception.
testing.done: access provisioning and revocation are independently verified against the IAM log for the sampled review.

testing.step: Trace the FIA remediation plan to actual corrective action
actions: In a review year, pull the FIA operational review report findings and the company's remediation plan.
Confirm each corrective action was implemented by its committed date.
Flag any unimplemented or late corrective action as an exception.
testing.done: remediation plan actions are traced to implementation with unimplemented items flagged.

testing.step: Verify retention labelling and searchability

Confirm the 7-year retention label is applied and the item is searchable by event/declaration number.
Flag any missing or mislabelled record as an exception.
testing.done: retention labelling and searchability are confirmed for every sampled item.

Carry unresolved exceptions into the next cadence or review cycle as mandatory items.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and carry-forward commitment.

Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have an independent reviewer who performed none of the sampled re-performance sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion to the Audit Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion exists and results are reported to the Audit Committee.

checklist.step: Capture the current government wording for each required item

Save each as a dated PDF capture named <form>-<yyyy-mm-dd>.pdf in the form-library source folder.
Note the Manual section and revision date each capture came from.
checklist.done: a dated government-text capture exists for every required form and notice, sourced to its Manual section and revision date.

checklist.step: Build or update the templates in the policy administration form library
actions: In the policy administration system open Product Configuration ▸ Forms Library and locate or create the entry for each SFIP/notice template.
Enter the government wording verbatim, character for character, with no company boilerplate inserted into the operative text.
Map merge fields (insured name, property address, coverage limits, effective dates) to the correct policy data elements.
Save the template as a new version rather than overwriting the prior approved version.
checklist.done: each template is built or updated verbatim with correctly mapped merge fields, saved as a new version.

checklist.step: Map each notice to its triggering correspondence event
actions: In the correspondence configuration, confirm the renewal notice fires on the renewal-offer batch, the non-renewal/expiration notice fires on the non-renewal decision event, and mandatory-purchase/flood-hazard disclosures fire at new-business issuance.
Confirm the SFIP itself is attached to every issuance and renewal packet, never merged into or replacing another policy's forms.
Test-fire each trigger in the non-production environment and confirm the correct template renders.
checklist.done: every notice fires from the correct event and each trigger was test-fired successfully in non-production.

checklist.step: Verify timing rules against the required lead time
actions: Read the required delivery lead time for each notice (e.g., renewal notice lead days, non-renewal notice lead days) from the current Manual section.
Configure the correspondence batch schedule in the policy administration system to generate each notice within that lead time ahead of the triggering date.
Confirm the configured lead time on a test policy by checking the generated notice date against the policy's renewal/expiration date.
checklist.done: each notice's batch schedule is configured to the required lead time and confirmed on a test policy.

checklist.step: Run a side-by-side comparison against the government text
actions: Render a sample of each updated template with test data and place it side by side with the dated government-text capture.
Compare every clause, heading and disclosure statement word for word.
Log any discrepancy and correct the template before proceeding to review.
checklist.done: every updated template passes a word-for-word side-by-side comparison against the government-text capture.

checklist.step: Route the updated templates for compliance review
actions: Independently review each updated template against the government-text capture without relying on the preparer's comparison notes.
Confirm the timing configuration matches the required lead time.
Approve or reject each template with written comments; rejected templates return to the Policy Forms Specialist for correction.
checklist.done: every updated template carries a written Regulatory Counsel approval or a documented rejection with corrections made.

checklist.step: Promote approved templates to production
actions: Migrate the approved template version from the non-production environment to production using the standard release process.
Confirm the effective date of the new template version aligns with the FEMA-mandated effective date.
Retire the prior version so it can no longer be selected for new correspondence, retaining it in version history.
checklist.done: the approved template is live in production on the mandated effective date, with the prior version retired but retained.

checklist.step: Confirm the SFIP is never issued as an endorsement to another policy
actions: Review the policy administration system's product bundling rules to confirm flood coverage cannot be selected as an endorsement on a homeowners or commercial package policy.
Test-attempt to add flood coverage as an endorsement in the non-production environment and confirm the system blocks it.
Document the block test result.
checklist.done: the system is confirmed to block flood coverage from being added by endorsement, with the block test documented.

checklist.step: Log any wording or timing deviation found

Route to the Head of Compliance for sign-off before closure.
checklist.done: every deviation is logged with the correction and its go-live date, signed off by the Head of Compliance.

checklist.step: Notify Claims and Customer Service of any material change
actions: Where a notice's coverage-limitation wording changes, brief Claims Operations and the Contact Center on the new language before it goes live.
Update any internal script or FAQ that quotes the old wording.
Confirm the briefing occurred before the new template's effective date.
checklist.done: Claims and Customer Service are briefed on material wording changes before the new template goes live.

checklist.step: Sample-check live correspondence after go-live

Confirm the rendered document matches the approved template exactly, including merge-field population.
Escalate any rendering defect to the Policy Admin Ops Lead immediately.
checklist.done: 5 live notices are confirmed to match the approved template exactly, with any defect escalated immediately.

checklist.step: Maintain the form-library version history

Reconcile the version history to the policy administration system's own change log quarterly.
Resolve any discrepancy between the two logs.
checklist.done: the version history is complete, reconciled quarterly to the system change log, with discrepancies resolved.

Identify any Manual section not yet reflected in the library.
Open a form-library update task for each gap found.
checklist.done: an annual full-library review is complete with an update task opened for every identified gap.

Present the summary to the Head of Compliance.
Record any directed follow-up action.
checklist.done: the Head of Compliance has received the annual form-library status summary with follow-up actions recorded.

Apply the 7-year retention label and confirm searchability by form name and effective date.
Archive the annual full-library review record.
checklist.done: form-library evidence is filed, retention-labelled and searchable by form name and effective date.

Flag any mismatch as an exception.

Flag any live document that does not match the approved version as an exception.
testing.done: live-issued correspondence is traced to the correct approved template version for the sample.

Confirm the system blocks the attempt.
Flag any successful endorsement attempt as a critical exception.
testing.done: the endorsement block is independently re-tested and confirmed, or flagged as a critical exception.

testing.step: Verify Regulatory Counsel approval evidence on the sample

Flag any template live without a pre-dated approval as an exception.
testing.done: Regulatory Counsel approval timing is confirmed for every sampled template version.

testing.step: Verify retention labelling and searchability
actions: Open the compliance evidence repository entry for each sampled template.
Confirm the 7-year retention label is applied and the record is searchable by form name and effective date.
Flag any missing or mislabelled record as an exception.
testing.done: retention labelling and searchability are confirmed for every sampled template's evidence.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the template, the specific deviation and the affected notice.
Assign a root cause and an owner, and set a remediation date.
Carry unresolved exceptions into the next annual review as mandatory retest items.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and retest commitment.
